title: Product and Research Operations Manager, Voices
description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product and Research Operations Manager to run the operational backbone of Cartesia's Voice function - supporting voice production for customers, talent sourcing and logistics, and voice delivery for Go-To-Market and Customer Success. You'll work directly alongside our Voice Production Lead and Voice Library Lead, and provide hands-on support across their respective work-streams.

Part of your time will go toward cross-functional ad-hoc operations, including supporting growth initiatives.

YOUR IMPACT

- Voice Production & Library - Support execution of voice production runs alongside the Voice Production Lead. Over time, you'll own day-to-day production and library health reporting, take on more locales and volume, and build automations to streamline the process.

- Sourcing & Talent logistics - Support voice sourcing alongside the Voice Library Lead. Build the systems to source, vet, and create voices for the voice library with voice acting talent as well as vendors.

- Customer Voice Delivery & Enablement - Own customer-facing voice engagements end to end, driving customers to be successful with our models. Drive voice-related GTM enablement.

- Ad-hoc Strategy and Growth Projects - Support ad-hoc strategy & operations work, especially around our modeling products for TTS, STT, and other bets. Support Cartesia’s growth in international markets on a project by project basis.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3 - 6 years as an operator at a high-growth tech startup or in strategy consulting (MBB or similar)

- High agency - a proactive self-starter who can operate autonomously to get things done in ambiguous environments

- Customer-facing chops, with the ability to drive conversations with executives

- Semi-technical - comfortable using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, etc to build lightweight systems, and understands core concepts of system design

- Genuine interest in operating with founder-level hunger, and real enthusiasm for voice and audio technology - you have opinions on it, not just interest

What makes a strong candidate:

- Experience in the AI industry, especially in AI Strategy and Operations or Product Operations roles

- A track record of going out of your way to get things done proactively

- Builds lightweight systems autonomously

- Detail-oriented under volume; maintains attention to detail even with large volume of tasks

- Credible in front of GTM teams and customers without needing a lead in the room

MORE DETAILS

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.
The Role
As an Engagement Manager in our Global Analytics , you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
Veeva Analytic Business Consulting removes the legacy barrier of data preparation by bringing pre-integrated, industry best-in-class data to generate high-impact insights. Our analyses jump start field activation, pinpoint the right patient populations and HCPs, driving higher engagement and improving patient outcomes.
What You'll Do

•
Strategic Delivery: Act as the end-to-end lead on Veeva’s most complex, large-scale, and global engagements

•
Account Leadership: Build and navigate senior customer relationships, leading proposals for significant project wins and driving long-term account strategy

•
People Leadership: Lead and inspire teams of 4+ consultants across multiple projects simultaneously, fostering a culture of excellence

•
Financial Oversight: Manage project budgets of $1M+, acting as the primary point of contact for project health and commercial success

•
Practice Building: Support brand-building activities and the development of internal IP to keep Veeva Business Consulting at the forefront of the industry

Requirements

•
Experience: 8+ years in Life Sciences Consulting (Business or Management Consulting preferred)

•
Leadership: Proven track record of managing large project teams and $1M+ engagements

•
Domain Knowledge: Proven expertise in varying healthcare data sets (claims, engagement, and reference) and industry-specific analytics use cases such as segmentation & targeting, call planning, forecasting, and field deployment

•
Mindset: A highly analytical approach to problem-solving with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher

Nice to Have

• Deep knowledge of Veeva products

• Previous analyst-level work with working knowledge and proficiency of SQL and/or Python

• Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

• Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

• Retirement programs

• 1% charitable giving program

• Unrivaled career progression in a fast-growing, global team

• Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

• Base pay: $85,000 - $210,000

title: AI Trainer with Norwegian language
description:
About the Project
We are working on an initiative that supports the development of next-generation AI systems by creating data that helps train and evaluate advanced language models. As an AI Trainer, you will design lifelike interactions that showcase how virtual assistants can reason, use digital tools, and respond naturally to user needs.
Your work will directly shape how AI assistants handle real-world tasks - whether scheduling a meeting, navigating directions, or responding to open-ended questions - by building conversations that feel authentic, practical, and engaging.
The job is part-time: 20 hours/ week.
Responsibilities:

• Create detailed, multi-turn conversations that reflect everyday interactions between people and AI assistants.

• Simulate both sides of the exchange, including the assistant’s reasoning and tool usage when needed.

• Decide when digital tools should be used, ensuring interactions follow a clear and logical flow.

• Develop dialogue samples that demonstrate:

• Smooth completion of realistic tasks

• Recognition of limitations when tasks are impossible

• Natural, human-like conversation when no tools are required

• Consistently apply internal guidelines to keep outputs accurate and high-quality.

• Revise and refine examples based on feedback, focusing on clarity and realism.

• Work with peers to ensure consistency and alignment across all deliverables.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of professional experience in a technical, analytical, or problem-solving role.

• Native or professional proficiency in Norwegian language .

• Familiarity with programming concepts, APIs, and structured data formats such as JSON (specific tech stack not required).

• Strong analytical and logical thinking skills with the ability to model decision-making processes.

• Exceptional written English with attention to clarity, tone, and nuance.

• Creative mindset and ability to design scenarios that feel natural and relevant.

• Experience with AI assistants, large language models, or tool-driven frameworks (a plus, but not essential).

• Consistency in following structured workflows and formatting requirements.

• Professional fluency in English and at least one of the designated target locales.

title: Financial Crime Officer
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

YOUR MISSION

At Teya we are building the future of fintech for small businesses, and our Compliance and

Financial Crime team is at the core of this journey. As a Financial Crime Officer in the

second line Compliance team, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening our defences by

filing Suspicious Activity Reports and implementing and improving policies and processes

to keep pace with changing regulation and evolving trends in financial crime. You will

collaborate closely across first-line Operations, Product, Legal and Risk teams to uphold

our standards and safeguard integrity in a high-growth environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Report directly to the Head of Compliance and work in an enthusiastic, forward-thinking and motivated second line Compliance team.

- Conduct comprehensive Enhanced Due Diligence ("EDD") reviews on high-risk customers and manage Suspicious Activity Reports ("SARs") to the National Crime Agency and Financial Intelligence Units.

- Oversee regulatory policy monitoring and change management, staying at the forefront of evolving AML & CTF and sanctions regulations, and advising relevant teams on required process adjustments.

- Help develop Teya’s internal KYC and KYB tools and drive process improvements and automation within the financial crime control environment - identifying gaps, proposing enhancements to EDD workflows, SAR quality, alert parameters, and monitoring tools to make controls more efficient and effective.

- Perform second‑line oversight and quality assurance of first-line controls, alert handling, case management, and EDD outputs.

- Collaborate across functions, including Legal, Risk and Operations, providing advice to ensure alignment with Teya’s policies and regulation.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5-6 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Financial Crime, AML & CTF roles - ideally in fintech, digital banking, credit or financial services.

- University degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

- Strong knowledge of UK and EU AML regulations, e.g. FCA, JMLSG guidance, MLRs, POCA, FATF and Basel standards.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of clear, concise advice, procedures, SARs, policies and regulatory communications.

- Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, such as analysing workflows, identifying inefficiencies and recommending enhancements to tools, policies and procedures.

- Whilst not required, professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA Advanced AML, CFCS and strong data or analytical skills (e.g. SQL, Excel) are desirable.

- We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long it suits both you and you team

title: Program Manager
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Metrea is actively building its presence in Australia as part of a deliberate, globally coordinated expansion into the Asia-Pacific region. Our Asia-Pacific Market Group, headquartered in Brisbane with an additional office in Perth, is the enterprise's dedicated regional interface - connecting Australia's national security community with Metrea's full suite of capabilities across three core domains: Aerospace, Electromagnetic & Cyber, and Digital & Synthetic. Metrea is now bringing that same depth of mission expertise and proven operating model to Australia.

Underpinning these capabilities is a global network of Support Groups spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement - ensuring that as we grow in Australia, we do so with the full weight of an established global enterprise behind us.

Metrea's solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving - enabling our partners to scale capacity and achieve asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management capability with aviation operational experience and an appreciation for the complexities of aircraft sustainment, mission execution, and outsourced maintenance relationships.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Frontier Assurance team strengthens OpenAI’s safety decisions through independent expertise, rigorous assessment, and public transparency. We coordinate external evaluations of frontier models and safeguards, develop approaches such as embedded auditing, and manage the misalignment disclosure process and safeguard testing. Our work helps independent experts scrutinize OpenAI’s safety approach and ensures their findings inform consequential decisions about advanced AI systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a researcher on Frontier Assurance, you will build the technical foundations for rigorous assessments of frontier AI risks. You will help design technical assessments with external evaluators and internal teams: identify consequential safety claims to test, define the evidence and methods needed to assess them, and address gaps in coverage.

You will work closely with external evaluators and embedded auditors, helping them understand the systems they are assessing and access the models, data, and technical information their work requires. Where direct access is not possible, you will conduct experiments and analyses on their behalf, with methods and results they can meaningfully scrutinize.

This role combines research engineering, experimental design, and close technical collaboration. You will move between investigating specific safety questions, navigating complex internal systems, and building reusable tools that make assessments more thorough and efficient. Your work will help turn independent scrutiny into concrete evidence about model capabilities, safeguards, and remaining risks.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Help design assessments with external evaluators and internal teams: identify consequential safety claims to test, define the evidence and methods needed to assess them, and address gaps in coverage.

- Pair closely with external researchers to provide the data, technical documentation, and context needed to assess models and safeguards. Help them understand relevant system behavior, configurations, and limitations.

- Design and implement secure access to assessment environments, working with research, engineering, and security teams to make relevant models, tools, and information available.

- Conduct experiments and run analyses on evaluators’ behalf when direct access is constrained. Develop methods collaboratively, document implementation choices, and make results reproducible and open to challenge.

- Build tooling that automates auditing, assessment workflows, and internal assurance work, including evidence collection, evaluation execution, and tracking changes across model or safeguard versions.

- Reproduce external findings, investigate discrepancies with internal results, and work with relevant teams to test proposed mitigations and identify unresolved questions.

- Document methods, findings, and limitations clearly so that evaluators and internal decision-makers can understand what the evidence establishes and where uncertainty remains.

- Have strong software engineering skills and experience building research tools, evaluation infrastructure, or systems for analyzing complex data.

- Can navigate unfamiliar codebases and infrastructure, debug across system boundaries, and turn ambiguous research requests into reliable technical implementations.

Execution & Integration

· Coordinate closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and related teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation
· Contribute to continuous improvement of M&A Total Rewards playbooks, tools, and templates based on deal learnings
· Provide project management support for Total Rewards activities across the M&A lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution and issue resolution

• Contribute to broad-based compensation activities, including benchmarking and retention analysis, and support annual compensation planning cycles

• Experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, and/or M&A related HR work

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie - von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One http://Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Analyse von Märkten, Wettbewerbern und neuen Geschäftsmöglichkeiten

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Business-Development- und Wachstumsstrategien

- Identifikation und Bewertung potenzieller Partnerschaften und Marktchancen

- Erstellung von Analysen, Business Cases und Entscheidungsvorlagen

- Unterstützung bei Go-to-Market- und Market-Entry-Projekten

- Analyse und Optimierung von Vertriebs-, CRM- und Pipeline-Prozessen

- Eigenständige Bearbeitung strategischer und operativer Projekte

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und externen Partnern

DEIN PROFIL

- Studium in einem wirtschafts-, sozial-, ingenieur- oder quantitativ ausgerichteten Fach, z. B. BWL, Business Administration, Management, Economics, Finance, International Business, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

- Studium an einer renommierten Universität oder Business School; idealerweise an einer der führenden Hochschulen in Deutschland oder Europa

- Erste praktische Erfahrung in Business Development, Strategy, Growth, Consulting, Startups, Scale-ups, Tech-Unternehmen oder Venture Capital von Vorteil

- Starkes analytisches und unternehmerisches Denken sowie eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise

- Interesse an Geschäftsmodellen, Märkten und Wachstum

- Hohe Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN

- Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

- Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

- Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

- Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

- Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

- Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

- Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Vice President of Strategy
locationText: Remote; Washington, D.C. or Los Angeles preferred
description:
Thank you for considering Oklo. We are hiring a Vice President of Strategy to build and lead our corporate Strategy function.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Vice President of Strategy to serve as the senior leader of the company’s corporate strategy function. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, you will shape Oklo’s enterprise strategy, lead the Strategy team, and help the company make and execute its most consequential decisions.

The function is designed to be proactive and high leverage: identifying emerging opportunities and risks, developing independent points of view, and deploying a focused team against the company’s highest-priority questions and initiatives. You will set the function’s agenda and standards, determine where Strategy resources can have the greatest impact, and lead work from early thesis development through executive decision, execution, and handoff.

You will work directly with the founders, CFO, and business-unit leaders, bringing forward original recommendations, constructively challenging assumptions, and leading the Strategy function’s contribution to executive and Board decisions. You will be accountable for the quality of company-level strategy, the effectiveness of the Strategy function, and the impact of the initiatives it leads.

Specific responsibilities include:

• Build and lead the corporate strategy function. Design the function's operating model; hire, develop, and manage talent; allocate resources; and own the standards, quality, and results of the team.

• Own enterprise strategy. Lead the development and refinement of Oklo's long-range strategy, including portfolio choices, priority markets, business models, growth platforms, and the allocation of leadership attention and company resources.

• Set a proactive strategic agenda. Identify important opportunities, risks, and unanswered questions before they are formally assigned. Sponsor the right analysis and recommend what the company should pursue, defer, reshape, or decline.

• Lead strategic planning and performance reviews. Own the Strategy team's delivery of annual and multi-year planning, objectives and key results, scorecards, and initiative reviews.

• Shape major corporate choices. Support the strategic evaluation of partnerships, creative capital initiatives, acquisitions, new ventures, international opportunities, and structural options in collaboration with the relevant business units and functional owners.

• Own the strategic-initiative portfolio. Establish objectives, accountable leaders, milestones, decision points, and review mechanisms. Recommend when to advance, resource, redirect, stop, or hand off work.

• Advise executive leadership and the Board. Bring independent, evidence-based recommendations; challenge assumptions constructively; frame alternatives and tradeoffs; and lead consequential strategic discussions.

• Personally lead selected high-stakes initiatives. Take direct responsibility for a small number of the company's most important initiatives through decision, launch, transaction, or a clear operational handoff.

• Integrate strategy across the company. Partner with Finance, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, Legal, Government Affairs, international teams, technical and regulatory leaders, and business units so company-level choices remain coherent through execution.

• Build company-wide strategy capability. Establish rigorous methods for business cases, decision memos, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning, and coach colleagues to improve the quality and speed of decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

• Senior leadership experience. Substantial experience leading corporate strategy, general management, business building, or a comparable enterprise mandate, with a record of shaping company direction and driving implementation.

description:
About HubSync

HubSync is the AI-enabled workflow platform built for CPA firms. We replace the pile of point tools firms use to run an engagement (letters, data collection, organizers, document exchange, e-sign, e-file, payments, and analytics) with one unified system. Top 25 CPA firms already run on it. Backed by Thoma Bravo, we are scaling rapidly, and our product organization must scale with the same level of discipline.
Product Managers at HubSync are not ticket writers. You own a product area end to end: what gets built, why, in what order, and whether it is ready to ship. About the Role
We are seeking a high-caliber product leader to bridge the gap between complex tax/workflow domain needs and technical product execution. You will fully own the product roadmap, enforce strict sprint discipline, author unambiguous PRDs, and maintain cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, quality engineering, and executive leadership. What You Will Own

•
End-to-End Delivery: Own a product area from problem definition to shipped outcome. Author PRDs, obtain engineering and QE sign-offs, and record the go-live decision.

•
Roadmap & Prioritization: Manage and defend the quarterly roadmap for your product area. Priority requests are scored using RICE-no side doors or line-jumping.

•
Sprint Scope Discipline: Enforce strict sprint boundaries. Protect engineering capacity while leading sprint reviews with real demos and clear release notes.

•
Customer Signal: Partner closely with Customer Success to translate recurring request patterns and escalations into concrete product improvements.

•
Quality Standard: Drive quality jointly with Quality Engineering. Ensure acceptance criteria are met before shipping-never ship on hope.

•
Cross-Functional Command: Lead weekly PO checkpoints, executive recaps, and customer calls. Speak confidently for your product without waiting for direction.

What We Are Looking For

•
0-to-1 Experience: Proven track record taking a product from concept to launch. You owned the bet, the scope, and the outcome.

•
Startup Grit: 5+ years of experience in startup or high-growth SaaS environments. You excel in navigating ambiguity and finishing process frameworks.

•
Staff-Level Scope: Track record of multi-team influence, driving outcomes over output, and solving ambiguous problem spaces.

•
AI-First Execution: You actively utilize AI tools for research, drafting PRDs, synthesizing customer calls, and prototyping.

•
Clear Documentation: Exceptional writing skills. Your PRDs allow engineering and QA to build and test without extra decode meetings.

•
B2B SaaS Background: Experience in tax, accounting, professional services, or complex workflow automation software is a plus.

How We Work

•
PRD Standard: No epic enters a sprint without an approved PRD (PO, Engineering Lead, QE).

•
Single Source of Truth: One quarterly roadmap, strict RICE scoring, no side doors.

•
Locked Sprints: Locked sprint scope, live demos during sprint reviews, and accurate release notes.

•
Data-Driven Go-Live: Go-live decisions are recorded against PRD acceptance criteria with evidence.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We're the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals' health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: founded in 2023 and already one of Europe's top 100 AI startups, with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. We've attracted exceptional people from the likes of ElevenLabs, Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta, and AWS and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we're looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

- Own product areas end-to-end, from zero-to-one discovery through to shipping, measuring, and iterating in production

- Define and drive the roadmap for your domain, making hard prioritisation calls that balance customer pain, AI capability, and commercial impact

- Work at the intersection of AI and B2B SaaS. defining how LLM-powered features get embedded into clinical and operational workflows that vets actually use

- Run tight discovery loops with customers; getting into practices, watching how vets work, and translating messy real-world problems into sharp product decisions

- Collaborate daily with Engineering and Design to ship fast, without sacrificing quality or coherence

- Align with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure what you build lands well and drives measurable outcomes

- Define success metrics for every initiative and hold yourself accountable to them

- Contribute to how the product team operates, our processes are still forming and you’ll help shape them

Your background looks something like:

- Solid background as a PM at a SaaS company, ideally one that was building 0-1 products in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment

- Experience shipping AI-powered features, you understand what LLMs can and can’t do, and you know how to design around their limitations

- A track record of owning a roadmap and making difficult trade-offs under real constraints, not just managing a backlog

- Strong technical fluency, you don’t need to write the code, but you can engage meaningfully in architectural conversations

- Experience in health-tech, vertical SaaS, or a regulated industry (nice to have)

- Background at a FAANG company or high-growth VC-backed startup (nice to have)

As a person, you:

- Get energised by building from scratch, blank-page problems don’t intimidate you, they motivate you

- Are relentlessly driven by outcomes, not output, shipping a feature means nothing if it doesn’t move the metric

- Move fast and make decisions with incomplete information, then course-correct quickly when you’re wrong

- Have a genuine passion for product. you think about it outside of work, and it shows in how you talk about it

- Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ

- Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

- You’ve shipped something meaningful that customers are using and talking about

- You own your domain with confidence, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market trust your judgement and come to you first

- You’re already influencing the roadmap beyond your immediate area and shaping how the team thinks about AI-native product development

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. As AI systems grow more complex, NVIDIA 's multi-die packages have become some of the most challenging engineered products, connecting dozens of chiplets across substrates, interposers, and heterogeneous interfaces. The engineers who build the automation infrastructure for these packages don't just write software - they directly determine whether NVIDIA can tape out on schedule and at scale. This role is a rare opportunity to craft production-grade EDA tooling that operates at the bleeding edge of packaging technology, where no commercial solution exists yet and the problems you solve become the new industry baseline. • Work with world-class engineers to design and implement VLSI tools for silicon and substrate design.

• Develop applications to enable project engineers with an emphasis on maintainability and ease of use.

• Develop flows/tools and methodologies to construct, analyze, and validate package designs at many different stages in the production flow.

• Optimize the daily workflows of the world's top package designers.

• BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and 5+ years of flow and methodology development experience building flows for package design used by engineering teams at scale.

• Good programming fundamentals in Python and/or C++, including proficiency with data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and code quality practices.

• Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML techniques in engineering workflows - this could include using LLMs for code generation and debugging, building ML-assisted design analysis tools, or integrating AI-assisted flows into EDA environments.

• Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals relevant to VLSI package design (signal integrity, power delivery, parasitic extraction, or equivalent).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Good understanding of VLSI package design along with interposer and IC physical design.

• Strong expertise in developing package design flows and methodologies.

title: Software Engineering Graduate 2027
description:
Looking to kickstart your career and make a global impact? Join Ocado Group’s Graduate Programme and become a driving force in the future of technology.

Programme Overview

• Start Date: Early September 2027

• Duration: 2 years (Fixed-term, full-time)

• Location: Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City and London (hybrid)

About Us

Ocado Group delivers innovative technology solutions powered by the latest advancements in automation, robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, catering to the online grocery and non-grocery distribution sectors. With over 20 years of experience in the online grocery industry and a portfolio of patented technologies, we strive to transform the economics and service standards of grocery ecommerce on a global scale. A workplace culture that celebrates diversity, collaboration, and creativity. Discover more about Ocado Group’s story here . 

About the Role

Our rotation scheme is designed to give you first-hand experience of a range of areas from Bot Software to Data Science. As a graduate, you will rotate through multiple departments during the two year scheme in four different six-month placements, giving you a well-rounded understanding of the business. You'll work in teams across the Ocado Group division, gaining knowledge and insight into the vast number of challenges. Once you’ve successfully completed the programme, you can look forward to a long-term career with a huge amount of scope and knowledge from across the business.

Here are some of the areas you could be working in on the scheme:

Bot Software & Hardware: Builds next-generation bot systems and prototypes cutting-edge robotics solutions to enhance fleet reliability and performance.
eCommerce: Powers the Ocado Smart Platform's global web and native mobile apps, delivering high-scale search, personalization, and seamless shopping experiences.
Fulfilment : Develops the low-latency control systems, warehouse management software, and high-performance GUIs that drive highly automated warehouses.
Data: Drives cross-stream ML, data engineering, and advanced warehouse simulations to optimize control algorithms and test hardware before physical rollout.

About You

• Candidates typically have degrees related to (but not limited to) Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, AI, Robotics, Machine Learning etc. but we consider candidates from a wide range of academic backgrounds

• Have a real passion for quality coding and cutting edge technology

• Be a logical thinker

• Embody a collaborative approach to projects

• Don’t be afraid to think outside of the box

Note: This role does not qualify for Skilled Worker Sponsorship and requires full right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme.

Application Process

• Online Application: Share your background and client-facing career ambitions.

• Video Interview: Introduce yourself and showcase your communication skills.

• Online Tests: Demonstrate your numerical and problem-solving abilities.

• Assessment Centre: Collaborate with peers on real-world scenarios.

What We Offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here's a snapshot of what you can expect:

• Time to recharge : 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more - and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

• Health & wellbeing : Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

• Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.

• Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.

• Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

• Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com

description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We are hiring a Global Account Manager dedicated to one of Snowflake’s most strategically important enterprise customers. Depending on alignment, your client will sit within either Financial Services or Technology, Telecommunications & Industrial Manufacturing.

You will work closely with the marketing team to develop account-based marketing plans and will act as a trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their IT roadmap and positioning Snowflake as the solution of choice in the market. The Global Account Manager will also be responsible for prospecting, conducting initial meetings, managing the sales process, and ensuring ongoing customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities:

- Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts on a quarterly and annual basis through the development and execution of strategic sales plans across financial services or technology, telecommunications & industrial manufacturing enterprises.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement account-based marketing plans to drive revenue growth.

- Act as the trusted advisor to customers by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap and effectively positioning Snowflake as the solution of choice in the market.

- Identify and qualify new sales opportunities and develop ongoing revenue streams across key business units and divisions.

- Conduct initial executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings.

- Manage the sales process and close deals to meet revenue goals.

- Build and maintain strong relationships to ensure satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams.

- Utilize a value-oriented and solution-based approach to sales and possess excellent presentation, listening, organizational, and contact management skills.

Requirements:

- 10-15+ years of field sales experience with a focus on data or cloud-related technology preferred.

- Extensive experience working with strategic global customers.

- Can demonstrate opening and growing accounts from $m to tens of millions.

- Proven success in leading sales account teams aligned to the customer at a regional level.

- Experience closing seven-figure, multi-year deals and creating strategic account plans.

- Strong understanding of customer requirements and the ability to effectively present solutions and articulate business value and ROI.

- Demonstrated success in transformational and consultative selling, strategy development, and sophisticated negotiations.

- Executive-level relationship management experience and an understanding of the business drivers for C-level stakeholders.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders such as partner sales, marketing, value engineering, legal, etc.

- Deep industry and/or account-specific expertise within Financial Services (banking, capital markets, insurance) or Technology, Telecommunications & Industrial Manufacturing.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple opportunities and team members.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and time management skills.

- Familiarity with sales processes and pipeline management.

- Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools preferred.

- Comfortable managing remote opportunities and virtual team membe

title: Specialty/Non-Standard Claims Adjuster
description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

Salary: $64,000 per year (USD)

About the role

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Non-Standard Claims Adjuster to support our deposit replacement and surety programs. In this role, you will manage first-party claims involving non-standard policy language and complex contractual agreements. Success requires strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret policy forms, lease agreements, financial ledgers, and supporting addenda with accuracy and confidence.

You will work directly with property managers, policyholders, and internal stakeholders to drive fair, thorough, and timely claim outcomes. This role requires clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate nuanced coverage positions while maintaining a high level of professionalism and empathy.

This position is ideal for an adjuster who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoys working within specialty programs. The right candidate is adaptable, solutions-oriented, and comfortable balancing high claim volume with exceptional service delivery and compliance standards.

• Passionate adjuster. You care deeply about the customer experience and delivering fair, timely resolutions.

• Urgent but balanced. You work with a sense of urgency but understand that doesn’t mean working at all hours.

• Creative problem-solver. You find innovative ways to resolve claims efficiently while keeping the insured’s best interests in mind.

• Comfortable with conflict. You see conflict as a conversation, not a confrontation-an opportunity to collaborate and resolve issues.

• Curious. You want to know the whole story to make informed decisions early and drive prompt resolutions.

• Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were different-you take action to improve processes and outcomes.

• Communicative. You can break down complex topics, actively listen, and ensure clarity in every interaction. (What does this mean to you? We’d love to know!)

• Sense of humor. Claims are challenging-you know how to keep things light when needed.

What you'll do

• Provide prompt, courteous, and high-quality customer service.

• Manage a high volume of low-complexity claims; set and adjust reserves appropriately.

• Gather necessary information and documentation to initiate the claims process, explain coverage, and outline the next steps.

• Analyze contracts, financial ledgers, lease agreements, and addenda to determine claim validity and obligations.

• Ensure compliance with state regulations, policy provisions, and internal procedures.

• Communicate with all involved parties and issue payments within the set authority.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of claims guidelines, best practices, and workflows.

title: Chief Impact Officer

• Represent the organization in sustainability and impact-focused forums.

• Promote a purpose-driven and socially responsible organizational culture.

• Drive employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability and social impact.

• Foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee well-being programs.

• Lead and mentor sustainability, CSR, ESG, and impact teams.

• Build cross-functional collaboration around impact initiatives.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in impact strategies.

• Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and stakeholder engagement.

• Strong strategic and purpose-driven leadership skills.

• Expertise in ESG, sustainability, and social impact measurement.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication abilities.

• Strong analytical and program management skills.

description: ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET About Claims AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query. We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against. title: Team Lead SDR (m/w/d)
description:
WER WIR SIND

JUPUS baut die erste KI, die 80 % der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt. Series A abgeschlossen. ARR 2025 vervierfacht. Über 2.000 Anwält*innen vertrauen JUPUS täglich ihre Mandate an.

In drei Jahren sind wir zu einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal Tech Unternehmen in Europa geworden - mit 90+ Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin und einem international verteilten Tech-Team. Der Markt ist da. Das Produkt wirkt. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Jetzt geht es darum, dieses Momentum in echte Marktbewegung zu übersetzen - und genau hier kommt diese Rolle ins Spiel.

Outbound ist bei JUPUS kein Nebenkanal. Es ist einer der zentralen Wachstumstreiber - und du wirst ihn anführen. Als Team Lead SDR hast du direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell JUPUS in den nächsten zwölf Monaten wächst.

 

WAS DICH ERWARTET

Du führst ein Team von 12-15 SDRs im operativen Alltag: coachen, Calls mithören, Feedback geben, Energie hochhalten.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, dass dein Team heute gute Meetings generiert. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus starken SDRs die nächsten starken Account Executives bei JUPUS zu entwickeln.

Dafür arbeitest du eng mit dem AE-Team zusammen, entwickelst deine SDRs gezielt in Richtung Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung im Sales Cycle übernehmen können.

Viele Calls. Viele Neins. Und dann die Meetings, die den Unterschied machen.

Du weißt, wie das ist - und genau deshalb kannst du dein Team durch schwierige Tage führen, besser machen und auf den nächsten Karriereschritt vorbereiten.

 

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Team im Outbound-Alltag führen - Schlagzahl, Kontaktqualität und gebuchte Meetings als zentrale KPIs

- Calls mithören, direktes Feedback geben, Gesprächseinstieg und Einwandbehandlung praktisch vermitteln

- SDRs gezielt zu zukünftigen Account Executives entwickeln - gemeinsam mit dem AE-Team an Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing arbeiten und sie Schritt für Schritt an den nächsten Karriereschritt heranführen

- Talk Tracks und Playbooks weiterentwickeln - nah an der Praxis, nicht am Whiteboard

- Neue SDRs schnell ins Doing bringen und für ein starkes Zusammenspiel zwischen SDR- und AE-Team sorgen

 

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Echte SDR- oder BDR-Erfahrung - du kennst Kaltakquise aus eigener Praxis, nicht aus LinkedIn-Posts

- Erfahrung als Teamlead in der disziplinarischen Führung eines größeren SDR- oder BDR-Teams im High-Volume- und B2B-SaaS-Umfeld

- Hunter-Mentalität und die Fähigkeit, Energie ins Team zu bringen - auch wenn es mal zäh wird

- Deutsch auf Muttersprachler-Niveau

 

WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET

- Wirkung ab Tag 1 - Outbound aktiv mitaufbauen und prägen

- Kurze Wege - direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sales Leadership und Account Executives

- Flexibles Setup - Di-Do im Office , Rest flexibel

- Team & Benefits - Urban Sports, MacBook, Team-Events

 

KLINGT NACH DIR?

Kein perfektes Anschreiben nötig. Ein paar ehrliche Zeilen reichen.

Wir suchen keine lauten Egos - sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und andere wirklich besser machen wollen.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: [Flexible & Remote] Relocation Consultant, APAC
description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team - huzzah!

We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere - one move at a time .

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be-immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

About the role

Flexible Relocation Coaches work with PerchPeek to support current markets with surges in business volume, provide flexibility for Relocation Coach capacity, and improve coverage to support relocators across multiple markets and timezones. This role will work within a network of third-party consultants and with PerchPeek ’s Network Manager to deliver quality customer experience in line with customer requirements and PerchPeek ’s SLAs for quality and productivity.

Previous experience in the Global Mobility / Relocation industry and knowledge of relocation management and/or destination services is helpful, but not essential , as we’ll provide a free training course on how to become a successful Flex Relocation Coach. You’ll also receive paid training on all of our internal systems. You might be an awesome Relocation Coach if you’ve previously worked as a Customer Success Manager, Concierge, Personal Assistant, Support or Operations Specialist, or if you’ve worked in industries like travel, hospitality, SaaS startups, or HR.

Scope of Work

In more detail, Flexible Relocation Coaches will be contracted to deliver end-to-end Relocation Coach services to a diverse portfolio of relocators by:

• Building trusted relationships with relocators over the duration of their relocation journey as their main point of contact, delegating tasks when appropriate.

• Communicating with relocators via a) the PerchPeek app and b) through consultative and supportive calls to understand the customer’s needs, explain relocation services, and provide expertise, guidance & support to relocators within your portfolio.

• Handling difficult or complex relocator enquiries or situations, using critical judgement to ensure the best outcomes for your movers, including escalating these as appropriate.

• Providing the “right expertise at the right time” on all aspects of the relocation journey and life in the destination country to equip relocators to integrate successfully to their new location.

• Supporting relocators in understanding and abiding to their company’s relocation policy, including management of their relocation allowances.

• Recommending and coordinating additional relocation services from providers, working within PerchPeek ’s Supply Chain. Examples include immigration, tax or shipping providers.

• Systems Cleanliness: utilising Operations and Relocation Experience processes to the highest standards to help make sure that our teams and systems run smoothly. i.e. ensuring collected data is accurate and useful for data analysis, reporting, and insights.

• Process implementation: supporting the rollout of process improvements by engaging with new processes and tools.

title: Medical Director National OP Medicare
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews preauthorization requests for services. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work.

The Medical Director’s work includes computer-based review of moderately complex to complex clinical scenarios, review of all submitted clinical records, prioritization of daily work, communication of decisions to internal associates, and possible participation in care management. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances, these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.

The Medical Director may speak with contracted external physicians, physician groups, facilities, or community groups to support regional market priorities, which may include an understanding of Humana processes, as well as a focus on collaborative business relationships, value-based care, population health, or disease or care management.

Responsibilities
The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and determinations whether services provided by other healthcare professionals are in agreement with national guidelines, CMS requirements, Humana policies, clinical standards, and (in some cases) contracts. The ideal candidate supports and collaborates with other team members, other departments, Humana colleagues and the Regional VP Health Services. After completion of mentored training, daily work is performed with minimal direction. Enjoys working in a structured environment with expectations for consistency in thinking and authorship. Exercises independence in meeting departmental expectations and meets compliance timelines.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• MD or DO degree

• 5+ years of direct clinical patient care experience post residency or fellowship, which preferably includes some experience in an inpatient environment and/or related to care of a Medicare type population (disabled or >65 years of age).

• Current and ongoing Board Certification in an approved ABMS/AOA Medical Specialty

• A current and unrestricted license in at least one jurisdiction and willing to obtain additional license, if required.

• No current sanction from Federal or State Governmental organizations, and able to pass credentialing requirements.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Evidence of analytic and interpretation skills

• The curiosity to learn, the flexibility to adapt and the courage to innovate.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of the managed care industry including Medicare Advantage and Managed Medicaid.

• Utilization management experience in a medical management review organization, such as Medicare Advantage, managed Medicaid, or Commercial health insurance.

• Experience with national guidelines such as MCG® or InterQual

• Advanced degree such as an MBA, MHA, MPH

• Exposure to Public Health,
